answer: Payouts wait for random re-execution: jurors pick a receipt and require the identity to reproduce its deterministic output before a deadline, with a refundable bond burned on mismatch. The check is an opal set in the payment river: visible, hard, and impossible to split across copies. A comet of cloned keys leaves one fingerprint, so duplicates are clustered and paid once. One honest agent reruns its own job cheaply; a sybil farmer must fund bonds and real compute for every fake.
